verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Shared Drives as network storage accessible from multiple machines on a private network, which is separate from any single machine. Notebooks are also documented as having shared persistent storage for long-term development across notebooks, so datasets and checkpoints can outlive a single GPU session. However, the docs only imply that this storage survives instance teardown rather than stating it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that shared-drive data persists after a machine is deleted, details on attaching or mounting and on capacity and performance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
